design.scope: Liu and Rajwade unchanged source numeric coordinates; numerical consistency, not dimensional or biological validation
design.characteristic_scale: maximum absolute output over the independently integrated reference trajectory for this scenario
design.absolute_floor: declared state atol for state readouts; minimum declared state atol for derived readouts, in the stored source coordinates
design.constant_outputs: independent expected constant and unchanged absolute 1e-9 diagnostic
design.rationale: A predeclared one-part-per-million relative numerical accuracy target with a 1e-9 characteristic-scale floor avoids demanding identical floating-point representations for huge source coordinates. Independent reference refinement must consume at most 1% of that budget and each implementation at most 25%, leaving margin for cross-target agreement. This does not infer physical accuracy from the source-coordinate adapter.

legacy_scope: Other 31 scenarios retain their stricter existing absolute regression bounds; no new independent biological accuracy claim
